How To Develop A Telemedicine App : Tech, Process, Cost

Till date, if you wanted to see a doctor, you must schedule an appointment and go to the doctor’s office. But this was, in the past.

The majority of the world’s population was in lockdown to prevent the spread of the coronavirus outbreak. As many were unable to leave their houses at such times, contacting a doctor had become much more difficult. New medical technology solutions are being used to help us have easier access to medical services.

These are known as telemedicine app, and these are used to provide medical services to patients while also increasing the quality of care you receive. The use of electronic information and telecommunications technology in providing healthcare treatment is defined as telehealth by the Health Resources and Services Administration. It also includes the application of these technologies in medical education and clinical data administration.

The goal of the telemedicine app is to empower patients as well as their healthcare providers. Video medical consultations, remote monitoring, telehealth nursing, remote physical therapy, and psychiatry therapy are some of the applications. It has the potential to become a critical component of the healthcare business. If used appropriately, it may be extremely useful to the entire industry. The most recent Global Market Insights research backs this up.

According to the analysis, the worldwide telemedicine app market has grown from $38.3 billion in 2015 and is expected to grow by $130.5 billion in 2025. Many participants were polled to determine the rate of adoption of such technologies, and 70.5 percent claimed they are investing in the development of telemedicine apps. In 2014, this percentage was only 54%. The rate at which telemedicine software is being used in the industry is a good indicator that it will be the next frontier in medical care.

What is Telemedicine App?

Telemedicine, often known as telehealth, is the delivery of health-related services over the internet. It allows the medical professional and the patient to communicate without having to be physically present in the same room.

A telemedicine app is a tool that allows you to use telemedicine technology. It enables patients to obtain medical care in the privacy of their own homes. Medical specialists, on the other hand, can deliver therapy and get paid without having to sit in clinics for lengthy periods waiting for patients.

Working of Telemedicine App

  • In a telemedicine app, a patient books a video or live chat appointment through the smartphone app, just as he or she would in traditional ways. It mostly entails making use of current communication methods such as a toll-free phone number or an internet account.
  • When a patient wants a consultation or a medical visit using an app, he or she must provide basic personal information (name, email address, and age) as well as information regarding his or her health.
  • The request is either accepted or rejected by the physician. They can even put it off till later.
  • You can schedule a video visit with your healthcare providers depending on your condition like when one is fractured one can get on video call for follow-ups.
  • If you’ve been having stomach problems for a few days, you can schedule an appointment with your primary care physician via the telemedicine app.
  • If you’re going on an unanticipated trip, you can get an e-prescription within a day using the online chat feature.

Points to consider while constructing Telemedicine App

Certain features are required to attract more clients to your app, expand its reach, and assure its success. Here are some essential things to include in your telemedicine app:

  • For your app, go with a multi-platform strategy. The number of users of your program will dramatically rise if it performs well across iOS, Android, and web browsers.
  • It is critical to have a well-designed app interface that provides a positive user experience. Do not overburden your app with features that detract from the user experience.
  • Make your app compatible with wearable devices. The app’s features would be a good match for the gadget. As a result, it provides the user with a functional and practical experience.
  • To secure the security of health information and patient privacy, implement powerful security algorithms.
  • Make sure your app has a way for patients to provide feedback. This will allow you to make small modifications to your software and gradually increase its quality.

Have a look at – 8 Telemedicine Trends Shaping the Future of Healthcare Technology in 2023

The technology used in building Telemedicine App

The usefulness of a telemedicine app also influences the technology employed. It might be a modest app that connects patients with doctors. It can, on the other hand, be a solid platform for storing patient data, treatment histories, and other data. However, the following technologies are used in the majority of telemedicine applications.

Big Data

The healthcare sector is data-driven. To evaluate patients’ medical records, healthcare providers must store, handle, and analyze large volumes of big data computations. Big Data is used in telemedicine apps to deliver accurate diagnoses and better treatments.

Artificial Intelligence

Artificial intelligence (AI) is one of the most popular technology trends today, and it is widely used in the healthcare IT industry. To give a tailored experience to patients, telemedicine apps integrate AI-based language processing, chatbots, and voice recognition. Machine Learning is also used in these apps to assist clinicians in making faster and more accurate judgments about a patient’s treatment.

IoT

Other electronic gadgets, including tablets, medical displays, and digital cameras, are frequently connected to telemedicine applications. These apps can communicate with numerous devices using IoT technology, making a diagnosis, treatment suggestions, medication adherence, and other tasks easier. IoT allows medical hardware and software to be integrated, resulting in better patient care.

Blockchain

Healthcare organizations deal with personal information about patients. Telemedicine apps leverage Blockchain to securely store and exchange medical data.

Deep Learning

The telemedicine app can use deep learning to extract insights from massive amounts of medical data. This technology aids decision-making and enables health care practitioners to make more accurate forecasts about their patients’ health.

Cost included in the building of Telemedicine App

When a company decides to design a telemedicine app or engage a healthcare software development firm, the cost of app development is determined by the features that will be included in the app. As a result, the expected time for developing a telemedicine app is determined by the features, integrations, design, and complexity. The cost of development, on the other hand, is dependent on the geographic location from which you hire the developers. 

In a nutshell, if we consider the aforementioned elements, we can estimate the cost of developing a telemedicine app, which covers the creation of the mobile platform, backend, and admin panel. As previously said, do not take this as a final estimate. It may differ depending on your designs, features, and needs.

The anticipated cost of hiring an experienced mobile app development company for one platform – Android, iOS, or Web with basic features and functionalities – is roughly 70,000 USD – 100,000 USD. The development of this application is expected to take between 4 and 6 months.

Gearing to build Telemedicine App?

To meet your business and technical goals, you’ll need a dependable development partner who can deliver high-quality telemedicine app development.

Here’s how to locate one:

  • Decide the technologies you’ll use in your app based on the telemedicine software features you’ll require, and seek out professionals in that industry.
  • Look for a firm that understands how to create HIPAA-compliant telemedicine solutions.
  • Look for a company that is in a time zone that is convenient for you.
  • Create a disciplined workflow from the start, describe your goals explicitly, and share your product vision with the team.
